summary.text: Cyndi Howerton is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House of Representatives District 98 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a manager and was appointed to the seat after the death of Rep. Ron Howard.

paragraphs.text: Cyndi Howerton earned a bachelor's degree in business administration, and her career experience includes working as the manager of a personal income tax preparation company.
She was appointed to the Kansas House on August 5, 2021, to succeed Rep. Ron Howard, who died in July of that year, and took office on August 25, 2021.
Howerton ran for the Kansas House in District 86 in 2020 and lost the general election, and she was elected in District 98 in 2022 and 2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, and faces Democrat Erika Lewis in the general election.
